description: Turn any text into a URL-friendly slug: accents removed (é→e, ß→ss), lower case, non-alphanumerics replaced by a separator (- by default). Use for file names, URLs and IDs. Example: text=Crème Brûlée & Straße!, separator=-. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: slug
title: Make a URL slug
